name: Disenchant: Forestwood Bow can be disenchanted (COA-9502)
contract: The Forestwood Bow 1061534 is an uncommon item level 10 bow and uses disenchant bracket 21 like its Forestwood peers and stock uncommon item level 10 weapons. A character with Enchanting 300 casting Disenchant 13262 on it gets a disenchant loot window with at least one item, and closing it consumes the bow.

steps.label: the disenchant loot window holds materials
closing the loot window consumes the bow
